title: Two sources that appear to disagree
label: Demo data — synthetic
question: Is 0 a natural number according to this course?
student_answer: Lecture 1 says natural numbers start at 1, but the supplementary note mentions 0 is included.

chunks.text: In MTH101, the set of natural numbers N is strictly defined as positive integers {1, 2, 3, ...}. Non-negative integers including zero are denoted as N_0.
